curricula.name: Programmes de l'Éducation nationale (cycles 2, 3, 4)
curricula.note: France sets programmes per cycle: cycle 2 = CP-CE2, cycle 3 = CM1-6e, cycle 4 = 5e-3e. Mapped here as grade 2 = CE1, 3 = CE2, 4 = CM1, 5 = CM2, 6 = 6e, 7 = 5e, 8 = 4e. Topics are the programme domains (themes). Mathematics programmes were revised from the 2025 school year onward, so confirm domains against the current Bulletin officiel before use.
